RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_gamma_.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_gamma_weighted_facet_budget
RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalH_gamma_.expanded_type:
∀ {p m n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ p →
    ∀ (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1))) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
      (U : RectangleCLT.Face p → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (f : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Face p)
      (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {C δ σ h : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C →
        0 ≤ δ →
          0 < σ →
            0 < h →
              (∀ (j : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (U (f j)) = 1) →
                (∀ (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (s : ℝ),
                    0 < s → ν.real (RectangleCLTArxivV1.faceLayer (fun k => U (f k)) b s) ≤ C * (s + δ)) →
                  ∀ (q : ℕ),
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                        (fun z =>
                          RectangleCLTArxivV1.hardGaussianWeightedFacetIntegral (fun k => U (f k)) fun k =>
                            (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gammaAdjustedThreshold a h z.1 k -
                                RectangleCLT.faceDot (U (f k)) z.2) /
                              σ)
                        ((RectangleCLT.Companion.gammaRectangleLaw m q).prod ν) ∧
                      ∫ (e : ℝ × (RectangleCLT.Face m → ℝ)),
                          ∫ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
                            |RectangleCLTArxivV1.hardGaussianWeightedFacetIntegral (fun k => U (f k)) fun k =>
                                (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gammaAdjustedThreshold a h e k -
                                    RectangleCLT.faceDot (U (f k)) x) /
                                  σ| ∂ν ∂RectangleCLT.Companion.gammaRectangleLaw m q ≤
                        16384 * Real.exp (3 / 2) * Real.exp 128 * C *
                          (σ * (RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p * √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p)) +
                            δ * RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p ^ 2)
